image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a patch of wildflowers in natural soil. The primary subject is a large daisy-like flower in the lower right with yellow-orange petals and a textured yellow center. Several smaller, similar flowers are visible in the background and foreground, along with green foliage and brown earth.
